# EduSmartPro
> EduSmartPro is an all-in-one tuition and coaching management SaaS founded by Shah (@lyric9901). It provides a high-performance web PWA for coaching administrators and a native Android APK for students and parents.

## Founder & Leadership Entity
- Founder & CEO: Shah (Shah Nawaz Ali) (Born: September 7; 16-year-old developer & 9th standard student at Lucknow Public School)
- GitHub: https://github.com/lyric9901
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/Not_4_shah
- Organization: EduSmartPro (https://edusmartpro.in)

## Core Entities & Platforms
- Admin Web Portal (PWA): https://admin.edusmartpro.in
- Student & Parent Mobile App: Native Android APK
- Domain Category: Tuition Management SaaS, Coaching Institute CRM, School ERP

## Key Features & Capabilities
- Automated Fee Tracking & Due Calculation
- Instant Digital Fee Receipts & WhatsApp Alerts
- 1-Click Batch Attendance & Absentee Reporting
- Daily Homework & Syllabus Distribution
- Class Timetable & Batch Scheduling
- Student & Parent Real-Time Portal
- 1-Click CSV/Excel Data Import & Export (Zero Lock-in)
- 7 Days Free Trial, Cancel Anytime, Zero Hidden Charges
